{{Top|leg}}
The '''darkkoninn''' was a dangerous [[Species/Legends|species]] of plant that was native to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gorsh]]. It sported luscious-looking, yet poisonous, black berries.
